NS-E101.hint: Nightshift needs 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 on an x64 PC.

NS-E102.hint: Nightshift needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU with 16 GB. Check that the GPU driver is installed (nvidia-smi must work).

NS-E103.message: NVIDIA driver too old for this card (CUDA < 12.4; RTX 50-series cards need CUDA 13, driver 580 or newer).
NS-E103.hint: Install the latest Game Ready or Studio driver from nvidia.com/drivers, reboot, then re-run setup.

NS-E104.hint: Free some space on the drive that holds NIGHTSHIFT_HOME (empty the Recycle Bin, move old videos out of the Outbox); where the message gives the amount it needs, free at least that. Or set NIGHTSHIFT_HOME to a bigger drive.

NS-E118.message: GitHub did not hand out the update.
NS-E118.hint: GitHub answered with an error. A 403 or 429 means its hourly limit for update checks from this connection was reached: wait an hour and check again. A 404 means no release is published yet. A 5xx error is on GitHub's side: try again later.

NS-E119.message: A file could not be saved because another program is holding it open.
NS-E119.hint: Nothing was written, and an earlier version of the file (if there was one) is unchanged. Close whatever has it open (a video player, the File Explorer preview pane, a mail or cloud-sync program, a virus scan) and try again. If it keeps happening, check that the file and its folder are not read-only and send the diagnostics zip.

NS-E120.message: The file that holds your API keys could not be limited to your Windows account.
NS-E120.hint: Any account on this PC can decrypt that file (config\secrets.dpapi), so its permissions are its only lock. Nightshift locks a new copy before it puts any key in it and checks the lock again afterwards; when the first lock fails the file keeps what it had (the message says which step failed), and the keys in Windows Credential Manager are not affected. Try again. If the drive is FAT or exFAT Windows cannot keep it private (a USB stick or an external drive often is; such a drive has no file permissions at all): move NIGHTSHIFT_HOME to an NTFS drive. If it keeps happening on an NTFS drive, check that your account owns the Nightshift folder and that no other program (a sync or backup tool) changes its permissions, then send the diagnostics zip.

NS-E105.message: A required download site is unreachable.
NS-E105.hint: Check the internet connection and any firewall/proxy. Needed: huggingface.co, github.com, download.pytorch.org, api.pexels.com, pixabay.com.

NS-W106.message: NIGHTSHIFT_HOME is on a hard disk, not an SSD.
NS-W106.hint: Model loading will be slow. Consider moving NIGHTSHIFT_HOME to an NVMe/SSD drive.

NS-W107.message: Wake timers are not fully enabled in the power plan.
NS-W107.hint: The nightly task cannot wake the PC. Press Open power settings (or run powercfg.cpl), find Sleep, Allow wake timers, and choose Enable. 'Important wake timers only' is not enough for the 03:00 task.

NS-E108.message: PyTorch cannot see the GPU (CUDA unavailable or compute capability too old).
NS-E108.hint: In the tts venv run: uv pip install --force-reinstall torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128

NS-E109.message: A downloaded file failed its SHA256 check.
NS-E109.hint: Delete the file and re-run setup. If it fails again, the pin in manifest.json is wrong; report it.

NS-E110.message: A required tool failed to install.
NS-E110.hint: Install it manually (FFmpeg, from ffmpeg.org or with winget install Gyan.FFmpeg) and re-run setup. Git is not needed.

NS-E111.message: winget (App Installer) is not available on this PC.
NS-E111.hint: Setup downloads FFmpeg and the Visual C++ runtime directly instead. To use winget, install 'App Installer' from the Microsoft Store.

NS-W112.hint: Run as administrator: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem /v LongPathsEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f, then reboot. Nightshift keeps paths short meanwhile.

NS-E112.message: faster-whisper cannot run on the GPU (cuBLAS/cuDNN DLLs missing).
NS-E112.hint: In the studio venv run: uv pip install nvidia-cublas-cu12 nvidia-cudnn-cu12, then 'ns verify --quick'. Nightshift adds their bin folders to PATH automatically.

NS-E113.message: Antivirus or another program blocked a file Nightshift needs.
NS-E113.hint: Add the Nightshift folder to the antivirus allow list. For Windows Security, press Open Protection history, allow the Nightshift file there, then press Retry. Smart App Control blocks programs it does not know and cannot allow a single file: turn it off in Windows Security > App & browser control > Smart App Control settings (this cannot be turned back on without reinstalling Windows), then press Retry.

NS-E114.message: The Visual C++ runtime is missing and could not be installed.
NS-E114.hint: Look for a flashing shield icon on the taskbar and press Yes, or install it from aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe and press Retry.

NS-E115.message: The Nightshift program folder could not be put in the install folder.
NS-E115.hint: Extract the zip to a separate folder (for example C:\Users\<you>\Nightshift-Setup), close any window that has the install folder open, then run INSTALL.cmd again.

NS-E116.message: A network port Nightshift needs is already in use.
NS-E116.hint: Close the program using that port (the message names it), or restart the PC, then press Retry.

NS-E117.message: The install folder name has characters the model programs cannot open.
NS-E117.hint: Use a folder name with plain English letters, digits, spaces, - and _ (the model programs cannot open other paths).

NS-E121.message: The install folder or the NIGHTSHIFT_HOME setting could not be put in place.
NS-E121.hint: Setup could not create the folders in the install folder, or could not set the NIGHTSHIFT_HOME variable for this Windows account (this is not about free space). Check that the install folder is on a drive this account can write to, that no program or policy locks the account's environment variables, then press Retry or run INSTALL.cmd again.

NS-E122.message: This model is not made for this install's profile.
NS-E122.hint: Nothing was downloaded. The detail names the model and this install's profile; the voice design and story models need the GPU profile, so on this install use a preset voice and the one model it has.

NS-E123.hint: Nightshift looks in the folder named by NIGHTSHIFT_HOME, else in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Nightshift. Setup sets NIGHTSHIFT_HOME for your Windows account: open a new PowerShell window after setup, or use the Nightshift shortcuts. To use an install in another folder in this window: $env:NIGHTSHIFT_HOME = '<that folder>'. Nothing was downloaded or changed.

NS-E124.message: The program's list of locked dependencies (uv.lock) is missing or does not match pyproject.toml.
NS-E124.hint: This build is incomplete. Download the release again and run INSTALL.cmd; for an update, run ns update again with a complete package. No Python environment was changed.

NS-E125.message: runtime.json is missing or cannot be read.
NS-E125.hint: Run Nightshift setup again (INSTALL.cmd) and choose this install's folder. Setup writes a missing runtime.json again; one it cannot read it keeps as runtime.json.bad in the config folder and writes a new one from your answers (settings that were only in the old file are not carried over). If Nightshift is running, restart it afterwards.

NS-W113.message: A custom model was downloaded without a checksum.
NS-W113.hint: Nightshift cannot verify a file you named yourself, so it is not checked against a known SHA256. Use only models from sources you trust.

NS-W115.message: Could not read the NVIDIA driver version.
NS-W115.hint: Setup continues with the CUDA 12.4 build. If a video later fails on the graphics card, install the latest driver from nvidia.com/drivers and run ns verify.

NS-W116.message: On this drive Windows cannot keep the file that holds your API keys private.
NS-W116.hint: The drive that holds NIGHTSHIFT_HOME is FAT or exFAT (a USB stick or an external drive often is), and such a drive keeps no file permissions, so config\secrets.dpapi was saved without a lock. It is still encrypted for this PC, so it is useless on another one, but any account on this PC could decrypt it. The keys in Windows Credential Manager are not affected. To keep the file private, move NIGHTSHIFT_HOME to an NTFS drive. This warning is shown once, in setup or on the Settings page (whichever saves a key first), or as a note in the dashboard.

NS-W117.message: Nightshift cannot tell whether this work is still running, so it is being treated as running:
NS-W117.hint: Its lock file cannot be opened right now (an antivirus or backup program may hold it, or the folder lost a permission), and the process that started it is still running. Nothing was closed or restarted. Wait for the job to finish; if it does not, close Nightshift, restart the PC and check the folder data\owners for access rights. Once the process is gone Nightshift treats the work as interrupted by itself.

NS-W118.message: Nightshift cannot tell whether this work is still running, and no process is known to be running it:
NS-W118.hint: Its lock file cannot be opened right now (an antivirus or backup program may hold it, or the folder lost a permission). It is treated as running for at most an hour after it was last known to start (when no start is recorded: after its record or lock file was last written). After that it counts as interrupted: the next start of Nightshift or the next nightly run closes it and tells you how to continue it (for a video that was not finished, usually Retry in the Queue). You do not need to do anything. Release in the Queue does not change this (it frees the graphics card only). If it happens again, or Retry is refused, check the access rights of the folder data\owners.

NS-W119.message: The Desktop shortcuts open another Nightshift install.
NS-W119.hint: Setup left them as they were. This install's shortcuts are in its Shortcuts folder. To make the Desktop shortcuts open this install, run INSTALL.cmd again, choose this folder and switch 'Make the Desktop shortcuts and the ns and studio commands open this install' on, or put "shortcuts_here": true in the answers file.

NS-W120.message: The 'ns' and 'studio' commands do not open this install.
NS-W120.hint: Setup did not put this install's command folder on your PATH: the message says why. Type the full path of <home>\cmd\ns.cmd or studio.cmd, or run INSTALL.cmd again and choose Repair (when another Nightshift has the commands, also switch 'Make the Desktop shortcuts and the ns and studio commands open this install' on).

NS-W121.message: fake_gpu is set on an install that is not a dev or engine-test install, so it is ignored.
NS-W121.hint: The simulated graphics card is for tests only. Remove "fake_gpu" from answers.json (setup) and from config\runtime.json, then restart Nightshift (Stop All, then open the Dashboard).

NS-W114.message: A designed voice was chosen but the voice design model is not being downloaded.
NS-W114.hint: The voice cannot be created until the model is fetched: set include_voicedesign to true in answers.json, or run Settings > Models > Get voice design (ns models get voicedesign) after setup.

NS-E201.message: The graphics card was in use by another task, or by another model of this same task, so this one could not use it.
NS-E201.hint: Close Nightshift Code, or wait until the work that holds the graphics card is done (the Queue says what holds it), then start this task again; a story job that stopped part way shows Retry from where it stopped on its card. A nightly run tries again the next night while Automatic runs are on in Settings.

NS-E202.message: A service failed to start or crashed repeatedly.
NS-E202.hint: Run 'ns doctor': it checks the model files and the logs. If it names a damaged or missing model, run INSTALL.cmd again and choose Repair.

NS-E203.hint: The model did not answer in time after it started. If other programs were using the graphics card, the message says so (NS-E208). Otherwise run 'ns doctor'; if this happens again, run 'ns tune' once to measure what this PC can load.

NS-E204.message: The nightly scheduled task could not be registered.
NS-E204.hint: Try again in Settings > Schedule > Automatic runs. If Windows refuses again, run 'ns schedule install' from an elevated PowerShell, or create the task by hand in Task Scheduler (program: the Nightshift launcher, trigger: daily at your run time, wake the computer).

NS-E205.message: A new job could not get an id of its own.
NS-E205.hint: Nightshift drew many ids for today and every one already names a job, an upload or a download. That does not happen by chance: look in the Nightshift folder under jobs and imports for a very large number of folders with today's date, or for another program that is making them, then try again.

NS-E206.message: The nightly task could not be switched off, removed or read.
NS-E206.hint: Windows may still run it. To switch it off yourself: open Task Scheduler, select 'Nightshift Daily' in the Task Scheduler Library and choose Disable (or Delete). Settings shows what Windows has the next time it is opened. If Task Scheduler refuses too, do the same from a Windows account with administrator rights.

NS-E207.message: Nightshift refused a request that did not come from a program of this PC.
NS-E207.hint: Nightshift's engine, voice service and dashboard answer only requests addressed to 127.0.0.1 or localhost, and the engine and voice service answer no web page at all. If a web page sent it, close that page. A script of yours must address http://127.0.0.1:<port> (or localhost) and send no Origin, Referer or Sec-Fetch-* header, with a JSON body or none; when it changes something (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) its User-Agent must not name Trident or Firefox, the marks of old browsers that do not say which page sent a request. A tool that must post a form to the dashboard sends an Origin equal to the address it called: scheme, name and port.

NS-E208.message: Other programs were using the graphics card's memory, so a model could not be loaded.
NS-E208.hint: The message names the programs Windows reports. Close them (a game, a browser with many tabs, another AI program) and start again; a nightly run tries again the next night while Automatic runs are on in Settings. Nightshift never closes another program itself.

NS-E209.message: Nightshift's database is damaged and could not be replaced.
NS-E209.hint: Close every Nightshift window (Stop All), then open the Dashboard: Nightshift tries again. If the disk is full, free space first. If it still fails, run 'ns doctor --bundle' and send the zip.

NS-W205.message: The nightly task runs only while you are logged on.
NS-W205.hint: Windows refused the unattended mode (it needs an elevated PowerShell). Stay logged in overnight (lock the screen, do not sign out), or run 'ns schedule install' from an elevated PowerShell once.

NS-W206.message: The nightly task could not be registered.
NS-W206.hint: Setup carried on without it. Run 'ns schedule install' from an elevated PowerShell, or create the task by hand in Task Scheduler. Until then the nightly run starts only when you start it.

NS-W207.message: Automatic runs were switched off outside Nightshift.
NS-W207.hint: Switch Automatic runs on in Settings to get the nightly run back. The task 'Nightshift Daily' was removed or switched off in Task Scheduler, so nothing runs by itself now; the run time was kept.

NS-W208.message: Windows runs the nightly task, but Nightshift could not record it.
NS-W208.hint: Nightshift's pages say Automatic runs are off, or show the old time, until it can write the folder config again, while Windows runs Nightshift at the time shown in Task Scheduler. Make config writable (an antivirus or backup program, a full disk, or its permissions); the pages follow Windows within a minute after that. To stop the nightly run now, delete or disable 'Nightshift Daily' in Task Scheduler.

NS-W209.message: The nightly run could not start: the program folder is missing.
NS-W209.hint: Run INSTALL.cmd from a Nightshift zip of version 0.1.15 or later and choose the same install folder; setup puts the program folder back and the next night runs by itself. The note 'Nightshift did not run.txt' on the Desktop has the details.

NS-W210.message: A Python environment of Nightshift does not match its program: an update or rollback was interrupted.
NS-W210.hint: Nightshift finishes it the next time you open it from a Desktop shortcut, before anything else starts. If that fails, close every Nightshift window and run INSTALL.cmd from the zip of the version you have, choosing the same folder.

NS-W211.message: The nightly run left work for the next night to stay inside Windows' time limit for the nightly task.
NS-W211.hint: The note says what was left and how long each video takes on this PC. Fewer channels or fewer full videos a week fit more into a night; the next night continues what was left while Automatic runs are on in Settings.

NS-W212.message: Windows restarted the PC during the nightly run to install updates.
NS-W212.hint: The run continues the next night while Automatic runs are on in Settings. To keep restarts away from the night, set Active hours in Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options so that they include the run time.

NS-W213.message: A damaged database was set aside and replaced by its newest good copy.
NS-W213.hint: The note says which copy and what since then is missing. The damaged file is kept in data\damaged; 'ns doctor --bundle' includes its name for a report.

NS-W214.message: Nightshift's database could not be checked at its last starts, or a night made no nightly copy of it.
NS-W214.hint: The note says which and how old the newest nightly copy is. Close every Nightshift window (Stop All) and any other program that uses the Nightshift folder, free space on its drive if it is full, then open the Dashboard. If the note returns, run 'ns doctor --bundle' and send the zip.

NS-E301.message: The language model did not return a usable answer.
NS-E301.hint: Check that llama-server is healthy (ns doctor). A story job tries once more after a few seconds when the model sent a server error, the connection dropped or was refused, or the answer was empty; a timeout or a request the model rejects (a 4xx answer) is not tried again, so run the job again once the model answers.

NS-E302.message: The model's answer did not match the required JSON schema.
NS-E302.hint: Usually transient; the stage retries with a repair prompt. If persistent, the prompt or schema needs a fix.

NS-E303.message: A text validator rejected the story.
NS-E303.hint: See the detail for which rule (length, banned phrase, repeated opening, reading level).

NS-E304.message: No story passed the critic after 3 ideas.
NS-E304.hint: Lower critic_bar in the channel profile or widen the pools.

NS-E305.message: The long video's narration is under the minimum length.
NS-E305.hint: When the detail gives a length, it says how long the narration is and the minimum in effect: 9 minutes on a normal install, 2 minutes on an engine-test install made with tiny_story. A written story is expanded twice before this; for your own script, add text and run it again.

NS-E306.message: This format is not implemented yet.

NS-E310.message: The TTS engine failed to synthesize.
NS-E310.hint: Check logs\tts-*.jsonl; run 'ns verify --quick' to re-test the engine. The installer falls back to the reference engine if qwentts keeps failing.

NS-E311.message: Stored voice data is invalid or was made by a different TTS engine.
NS-E311.hint: Re-create the voice (design or clone) with the current engine; voices are stored under models\tts\voices.

NS-E312.message: Voice sample too short or noisy.
NS-E312.hint: Record a longer, clean sample of one speaker (no music or background noise) and try again.

NS-E313.message: Voice cloning needs the owner's consent.
NS-E313.hint: Tick the box that says you have the right to use this voice, then try again.

NS-E314.message: The voice design model is not installed.
NS-E314.hint: Run Settings > Models > Get voice design (or 'ns models get voicedesign'), then try again.

NS-E315.message: A voice could not be built from the recording or description.
NS-E315.hint: Use a clean 3-30 s recording of one speaker with the exact words typed in; run 'ns verify --quick' to re-test the TTS engine; see logs\tts-*.jsonl.

NS-E316.message: The embedding service did not return vectors.
NS-E316.hint: Check that the embed service is healthy (ns doctor), then run the job again: it resumes from this stage.

NS-W301.message: faster-qwen3-tts failed its smoke test; using the reference qwen-tts engine.
NS-W301.hint: Slower but equivalent output. See logs\tts-*.jsonl for the failure.

NS-W302.message: MTP speculative decoding was not faster on this machine; disabled.

NS-W303.message: The fake voice made tone bursts, which speech recognition cannot align.
NS-W303.hint: The Windows speech voice the test voice speaks with is missing or failed its start-up test. Install a voice (Settings > Time & language > Speech) or expect NS-E403 at the captions stage; it is the test voice, not a product fault.

NS-E401.hint: See the detail for FFmpeg's error. Run 'ns verify --quick' to test the encoder.

NS-W401.message: NVENC hardware encoder unavailable; using libx264 (slower).
NS-W401.hint: Update the NVIDIA driver, then run 'ns verify --quick' to re-test.

NS-E402.message: No usable stock clip found for a beat.
NS-E402.hint: The keywords were too narrow or the clip pool is exhausted. The beat falls back to a mood-only search; if that fails, widen seed_keywords.

NS-E403.message: Captions drift too far from the audio.
NS-E403.hint: The transcription did not match the script. Check the voice's speed setting.

NS-E404.hint: See qc\*.json in the job folder for the failing check and value.

NS-E405.message: This video cannot be used for clips (too long, no audio, or unreadable).
NS-E405.hint: Use an MP4/MKV/MOV under 4 hours with an audio track.

NS-E406.message: The video has too little speech to clip (under 30 words transcribed).
NS-E406.hint: Clips need spoken content. Music-only or silent videos are not supported.

NS-E407.message: No moments passed the clip filters.
NS-E407.hint: Try a longer length range, more clips, or a different channel niche; the transcript is kept so re-running is fast.

NS-W402.message: The requested clip layout did not apply (for example no facecam found); used center crop instead.
NS-W402.hint: Pick a different layout in Create → Clips, or leave it on Auto.

NS-W403.message: The setup test video did not finish.
NS-W403.hint: Setup can continue; run Diagnostics after install.

NS-W406.message: A Short failed the quality check and was left out; the master and the other Shorts were kept.
NS-W406.hint: See qc\dropped.json in the job folder for the item and the failing check (usually a length bucket). Nothing to do unless it repeats every night.

NS-W325.message: Every combination of this channel's variation pools was used in the last 30 days; one was used again.
NS-W325.hint: A series pins most of the pools, so its Shorts repeat sooner. Widen the channel's hooks or title formulas in Channels > Edit if it keeps happening.

NS-W405.message: Stock footage from an earlier video was reused for a scene.
NS-W405.hint: Every fresh clip for that scene's keywords was used in the last 14 days (30 across channels). Add seed keywords to the channel, or a second footage source key, so scenes get new clips.

NS-W404.message: Whisper runs on the CPU: captions will be slow.
NS-W404.hint: The graphics card could not run speech recognition (cuBLAS/cuDNN libraries missing or blocked). Videos still work. Update the NVIDIA driver, run 'ns verify --quick', or send the diagnostics zip.

NS-E126.message: Stock footage keys are still written in an answers file.
NS-E126.hint: Setup keeps the keys in Windows Credential Manager and blanks them in answers.json; it could not blank the file named in the message. Close any program that has it open and press Retry (or run setup again), or delete the key values from that file yourself.

NS-E127.message: A model file is damaged: its SHA256 or its size is not that of the file Nightshift downloaded.
NS-E127.hint: Run INSTALL.cmd again from the Nightshift zip and choose Repair: it checks every model file and downloads a damaged one again. Nothing else is changed.

NS-W501.message: The Pexels key could not be checked now.
NS-W501.hint: Setup kept it: Pexels was busy, failing, out of reach or answered in a way Nightshift does not read, which does not mean the key is wrong. The check before the first video asks again.

NS-W502.message: The Pixabay key could not be checked now.
NS-W502.hint: Setup kept it: Pixabay was busy, failing, out of reach or answered in a way Nightshift does not read, which does not mean the key is wrong. The check before the first video asks again.

NS-E501.hint: The Pexels key is missing or Pexels did not accept it: paste it again in Settings > Stock footage keys (no spaces). Pexels is optional; a Pixabay key alone is enough.

NS-E502.hint: The Pixabay key is missing or Pixabay did not accept it: add it (free) or paste it again in Settings > Stock footage keys (no spaces).

NS-E503.hint: No answer came, or the site is failing right now. Nightshift tries again; if the message says this PC could not reach the site, check the internet connection.

NS-E504.hint: Pexels allows 200 requests an hour and Pixabay 100 a minute; the key is fine. Nightshift waits as long as the site asks and tries again; nothing to change.

NS-E505.message: Stock footage site answer not understood.
NS-E505.hint: Pexels or Pixabay answered in a way Nightshift does not read; that does not mean the key is wrong. Try again later; if it keeps happening, update Nightshift.

NS-E601.hint: The story touched a blocked topic (see contracts/policy/unsafe_topics.yaml).

NS-E602.message: Policy gate: real person, brand or event detected.
NS-E602.hint: Fiction must not name real people, brands or real crimes/tragedies.

NS-E603.message: Policy gate: misleading claim in metadata.
NS-E603.hint: Remove 'true story', 'real footage' and similar from titles/descriptions/tags.

NS-E604.message: Policy gate: hook or title does not match the story.
NS-E604.hint: The judge found the promise was not delivered.

NS-E605.message: Policy gate: story too similar to a previous one.
NS-E605.hint: Embedding similarity above threshold; a new idea will be drawn.

NS-E606.hint: Too many tags, over 500 characters, or irrelevant tags.

NS-E607.message: Policy gate: selected Short does not stand alone.
NS-E607.hint: The moment needs context from the master; another moment will be chosen.

NS-E611.message: Policy gate: render too similar to a previous video.
NS-E611.hint: Perceptual hash matched an earlier render; visuals are being redrawn.

NS-E612.message: Policy gate: long-form runtime or mid-roll placement rule violated.
NS-E612.hint: Master must be at least 8:30 and mid-rolls outside the first/last 2 minutes.

NS-E613.message: Policy gate: stock clip reuse rule violated.

NS-E614.hint: Nightshift videos carry narration only, no music.

NS-E702.message: The update or rollback did not complete.
NS-E702.hint: The message says which version is in place and what is left to do. If it does not, run 'ns doctor --bundle' and send the diagnostics.

NS-E703.hint: Check that the zip was made by 'ns backup' and is not corrupted; nothing was changed.

NS-E704.message: NS_RELEASE_SOURCE (a test release source for the updater) is set and was refused, so no update server was asked.
NS-E704.hint: The text in brackets says why and what to do. NS_RELEASE_SOURCE is only for a dev or engine-test install and must name an address on this PC; on any other install remove it. Look wherever it can be set (the user and system environment variables of Windows, the shell or the scheduled task that starts Nightshift), then restart Nightshift (Stop All, then open the Dashboard), because a running engine and dashboard keep the environment they started with, and check for updates again.

NS-E705.message: Another update, rollback or repair of this Nightshift is running.
NS-E705.hint: Wait for it to finish: its window, Settings > Updates or run/update_state.json shows its progress. Nothing was changed.

NS-E706.message: Programs are still running from Nightshift's Python environments.
NS-E706.hint: Close the programs named in the message (a Studio or terminal window, Nightshift Code, a Python prompt), then run the update again. Nothing was changed.

NS-E707.message: The update package is not signed by a Nightshift release key this version trusts, so it was not installed.
NS-E707.hint: Nothing was changed. Download Nightshift-Update-<version>.zip with its .sha256 and .sig from the same release page and try again; if it is refused again, do not install that file and run 'ns doctor --bundle'.

NS-E708.message: This update needs a version of uv that Nightshift could not get.
NS-E708.hint: Nothing was changed. Connect to the internet and try again, or put the uv zip the message names (from uv's release page on GitHub) into the 'files' folder the message names (make the folder if it is not there), then run the update again.

NS-E320.hint: Fix the listed rule in config/channels/<slug>.yaml or via 'studio channel edit'.

NS-E321.hint: Change the niche, voice, caption styles or visual treatments of one channel.

NS-E322.hint: Run 'studio channel list' to see the configured channels.

NS-E323.message: The analytics CSV could not be read.
NS-E323.hint: Export the table from YouTube Studio again and keep its header row.

NS-E324.message: Calibration data is missing or incomplete.
NS-E324.hint: Run 'studio calibrate --channel <slug>' first and fill in every score.

NS-E325.hint: Widen the pools with 'studio channel edit' or wait for the 30-day ledger to clear.

NS-E326.message: Output not found or not in a state that allows this action.
NS-E326.hint: Run 'studio review' to list the outputs and their status.

NS-E329.message: This video is a test output and cannot be published.
NS-E329.hint: It was made on an engine-test install (tiny_story): a tiny model, a short length, placeholder voice and footage. Make the video again on an install without tiny_story to publish it.

NS-E330.hint: A paused channel makes no story video. Check its last videos, resume it (Dashboard > Channels, or 'studio resume <slug>'), then start or continue the video again.

NS-E331.message: The video could not be moved because another program has it open.
NS-E331.hint: The video is still where it was and its status did not change. Close whatever has it open (a video player, a browser tab that plays it, the File Explorer preview pane, a virus scan) and press Reject again.

NS-E408.hint: Check that the video has an audio track and that the whisper model is installed; run 'ns verify --quick'. For GPU errors see NS-E112.

NS-E409.hint: Check the link and that the video is yours or you have permission to use it; yt-dlp must be installed by setup.

NS-E328.message: A job was interrupted by a restart of Nightshift or the PC.
NS-E328.hint: Press Retry from where it stopped: the finished stages are kept. If it happens every night, check the PC's sleep and restart settings.

NS-E327.message: A job stopped on an unexpected problem.
NS-E327.hint: Other jobs were not affected. Open the log named in the report (logs folder) or run 'ns doctor --bundle' and send the zip.

NS-E411.hint: The captions model (whisper) did not load. Check that it is installed (Settings > Models), run 'ns verify --quick', and see NS-W404 / NS-E112 for graphics card problems. Videos cannot get captions until it loads.

NS-E410.message: Confirm that you have the right to use this video.
NS-E410.hint: Tick the box that says the video is yours or licensed to you, then start the clip job again.
